how_opened: Special Committee decision to approach 50 parties through BofA; NDA signers asked for preliminary indications.
who_was_in: 50 approached (15 strategic, 35 financial); 20 entered via NDA: 2 strategic (Party A, CSC/Pamplona) and 18 financial (incl. Party B, Party C). Party A entered by its 06/21/2013 bid; NDA 08/05/2013.
bids_received: 3: CSC/Pamplona, Party B, Party C (Party A's round-0 proposal of 06/21/2013 also reviewed)
how_it_ended: four advanced (Party A, Party B, Party C, CSC/Pamplona), sixteen out; Party B and Party C missed the 07/23/2013 due date but continued

how_opened: BofA letter asking the four admitted bidders for revised written proposals.
who_was_in: 4: 2 strategic (Party A, CSC/Pamplona), 2 financial (Party B, Party C)
bids_received: 4: CSC/Pamplona, Party B, Party A, Party C
bidders_bid: csc/pamplona; party a; party b; party c
how_it_ended: all four advanced to the final round; Party A and Party C missed the 09/09/2013 due date but continued

how_opened: BofA calls asking the four bidders for final indications of interest.
who_was_in: 4: 2 strategic (Party A, CSC/Pamplona), 2 financial (Party B, Party C)
how_it_ended: CSC/Pamplona selected, exclusivity 09/24/2013, signing 10/14/2013; Party C did not submit; Party A and Party B dropped at exclusivity
